# Target Advertising (تارگت للإعلان)

> Outdoor advertising, production, creative services, events and exclusive
> advertising on Alrabiaa TV, in Iraq. Website in Arabic (/) and English (/en/).

## What Target does
- Outdoor advertising (OOH): bridges, rooftops, walls, backlits, unipoles and LED screens in Baghdad, the provinces and on the southern and western highways.
- Exclusive distributor for advertising and promotion on Alrabiaa TV.
- Production: TV commercials, audio production, 3D videos, storyboarding and animation, AI commercials. 35+ high-production campaigns and TV commercials.
- Creative services: campaigns, social media content, branding and identity, AI videos and design, 3D design, UI/UX design.
- Media booking and planning, marketing services and events management.
